verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents AuthKit as a "customizable hosted UI for authentication" within a full authentication platform. It supports email + password, social login, passkeys, MFA and magic auth, which covers hosted sign-in and implies sign-up. There is no evidence of prebuilt embeddable UI components or of profile-management UI. The only related item is storing additional user and organization data, which is a data capability, not a profile screen. Missing for 10: prebuilt embeddable UI components, profile-management UI, explicit sign-up flow documentation, details of hosted-page customization, independent or hands-on corroboration.
